label: Tate's thesis and adelic zeta integrals
gloss: Formalizes Tate's thesis: integrals over the ideles that give the Dedekind zeta function and Hecke L-functions.

label: Quasi-characters and Hecke characters
gloss: Defines quasi-characters and their decomposition, mainly as characters of the idele class group.

label: Heights on projective varieties
gloss: Defines height functions on varieties over number fields and proves bounds on them, using lattice and Hilbert-Samuel methods.

label: Theta functions and Weil representation
gloss: Builds theta functions and Weil-type representations for unitary and Heisenberg groups over number fields.

label: Adelic GL_n and ideles
gloss: Shows continuity and compactness facts about the determinant on adelic GL_n and the idele group.

label: Constant frames and quantum determinants
gloss: Constructs constant frames and quantum determinant polynomials used to prove Fourier decay gauge existence.

label: Satake bounds and Hecke idempotents
gloss: Proves bounds on Satake parameters and builds Hecke idempotents for GL_n, using adelic tensor products.

label: Local fields and Artin conductors
gloss: Develops local fields, their Artin conductors, Lubin-Tate theory and the Kronecker-Weber theorem for local fields.

label: Abstract local reciprocity map
gloss: Builds the local reciprocity map of class field theory from abstract axioms on abelian groups.

label: Formal groups and Lubin-Tate series
gloss: Develops formal group laws, power series substitution and Lubin-Tate formal groups over local rings.

label: Lubin-Tate reciprocity via power series
gloss: Proves a reciprocity law for local fields using power series and Lubin-Tate descent.

label: Quadratic Weil representation over local fields
gloss: Shows that quadratic extensions of local fields are Galois and studies a Weil representation attached to them.

label: p-adic Hodge theory and perfectoid fields
gloss: Builds p-adic period rings and tilting for perfectoid fields, the core tools of p-adic Hodge theory.

label: Countable neighborhood bases for power subgroups
gloss: Shows that certain power subgroups have countable neighborhood bases, using lattice spans and descent.

label: Profinite group cohomology foundations
gloss: Sets up continuous cohomology of profinite groups, including Mackey double cosets and class formations.

label: Class formations and second cohomology
gloss: Proves vanishing and cyclicity facts for second cohomology in class formations of profinite groups.

label: Cohomological dimension of profinite groups
gloss: Shows that certain profinite groups have vanishing cohomology above a given degree.

label: Functoriality of group cohomology
gloss: Shows that inflation, restriction and connecting maps in group cohomology are natural.

label: Coinduced modules and acyclicity
gloss: Shows that coinduced modules of profinite groups have vanishing higher cohomology.

label: Compact support cohomology and cup pairings
gloss: Builds compact-support cochain complexes and cup pairings for profinite group cohomology.

label: Continuous cochains and long exact sequence
gloss: Shows that continuous cochains compute group cohomology and gives the long exact sequence for them.

label: Cup products in group cohomology
gloss: Defines cup products on continuous cochains and proves their functoriality and compatibility with connecting maps.

label: Discrete modules of profinite groups
gloss: Characterizes discrete modules of profinite groups by stabilizers of their elements and open normal subgroups.

label: Galois cohomology and Kummer theory
gloss: Computes Galois cohomology of fields in low degrees, including the Brauer group and Kummer sequences.

label: Galois modules and fixed fields
gloss: Relates Galois modules to fixed fields of finite Galois extensions and their subgroups.

label: Global class field formations
gloss: Builds the global class formation for number fields from idele classes, local degrees and Brauer invariants.

label: Global Euler characteristic formula
gloss: Proves a global Euler characteristic formula for Galois cohomology of number fields, with Shapiro's lemma and Poitou-Tate duality.

label: Inflation-restriction and transgression
gloss: Proves the inflation-restriction exact sequence and studies transgression for profinite group extensions.

label: Local class field formation
gloss: Builds the local class formation for local fields, with unramified classes and cup product symbols.

label: Local Euler characteristic formula
gloss: Proves the Euler characteristic formula for Galois cohomology of local fields and its vanishing cases.

label: Local Tate duality
gloss: Proves local Tate duality for Galois cohomology of local fields, using cup pairings and Kummer sequences.

label: Mackey formula for cohomology
gloss: Proves the Mackey formula for restricting and inducing cohomology along double cosets of profinite groups.

label: Poincaré duality for profinite groups
gloss: Proves Poincaré duality for profinite groups satisfying duality hypotheses, using dual representations and perfect pairings.

label: Poincaré pairs and compact duality
gloss: Builds duality pairings for compact groups and checks that they are compatible with cohomology maps.

label: Poitou-Tate duality theorem
gloss: Proves the Poitou-Tate duality theorem for global fields, linking global and local Galois cohomology.

label: Real places and Tate duality
gloss: Handles real places in Tate duality, including the cohomology of the complex conjugation action on local groups.

label: Restricted ramification and class groups
gloss: Studies Galois cohomology of number fields with ramification restricted to a finite set of primes.

label: Tate cohomology of finite groups
gloss: Builds Tate cohomology of finite groups, with its connecting maps, cup products and Herbrand quotients.

label: Additive valuation of products
gloss: Shows that the additive valuation of a product is the sum of the valuations, via a determinant over a discrete valuation ring.

label: Derivative of a determinant expansion
gloss: Computes the derivative of a determinant expansion over permutations, using the sign and trace of matrices.

label: Cardinality of filtered intervals
gloss: Bounds the number of elements of a finite set cut out by an interval condition.

label: Free lattices over p-adic integers
gloss: Shows that finitely generated torsion-free modules over the p-adic integers are free.

label: Valuation cancellation in volume ratios
gloss: Cancels valuation terms in a volume ratio over a Dedekind domain, using ideal factorization.

label: Cauchy estimates on coprime directions
gloss: Bounds the complex derivative of a function along directions, using Cauchy estimates and big-O asymptotics.

label: Clearing denominators in fraction fields
gloss: Shows that any element of a fraction field can be written with a common denominator in a monoid of generators.

label: Polynomial bounds on cofinite sets
gloss: Proves that a continuous polynomial bound holds on a cofinite set, using the fundamental theorem of algebra.

label: Lifting complements of submodules
gloss: Lifts a complement of a submodule through a surjection, using idempotent endomorphisms over a principal ideal domain.

label: Currying of product measures
gloss: Shows that the currying map on complex-valued functions preserves product measures.

label: Denominators in number fields
gloss: Finds a common denominator that makes a finite set of number field elements integral.

label: Determinant of positive semidefinite matrices
gloss: Bounds the real part of a determinant for positive semidefinite matrices of the form one plus a self product.

label: Hadamard inequality for determinants
gloss: Proves that the absolute value of a determinant is at most the product of its row norms.

label: Length of quotients of discrete valuation rings
gloss: Relates the length of a quotient of a discrete valuation ring to its additive valuation, using Smith normal form.

label: Dual Weyl divisibility pullback
gloss: Pulls back a dual Weyl divisibility condition along a row action on matrices of polynomials.

label: Fiber equations for complex places
gloss: Writes a sum over the fiber of complex places as a real-valued equation involving traces.

label: Polynomial evaluation degree bound
gloss: Rewrites the evaluation of a multivariate polynomial as a sum over monomials, grouped by total degree.

label: Quotients by prime ideals
gloss: Shows that a quotient of a commutative ring by a prime ideal maps onto the quotient by a larger ideal.

label: Ultrametric p-adic norm bound
gloss: Proves a norm inequality in the algebraic closure of the p-adic numbers.

label: Non-archimedean norm inequality
gloss: Proves a triangle-type norm inequality for differences in the algebraic closure of the p-adic numbers.

label: Integral elements of number fields
gloss: Shows that a rational expression of integral elements of a number field is again integral.

label: Ultrametric bound on real norms
gloss: Proves a triangle-type inequality for norms on p-adic complex numbers.

label: Maximal ideal of a local ring
gloss: Shows that the sum of two elements of a local ring's maximal ideal stays in that ideal.

label: Integral bases of number fields
gloss: Shows that the ring of integers of a number field has a basis and that sums of its elements are described by coordinates.

label: Jacobson radical of ideals
gloss: Characterizes membership in the Jacobson radical of a commutative ring through units.

label: Holomorphic extension on open sets
gloss: Shows that a function differentiable on an open ball is analytic there, using preconnected sets.

label: Nilpotent elements under algebra maps
gloss: Shows that an algebra homomorphism sends a nilpotent element to a nilpotent element.

label: Products and sums over multisets
gloss: Proves rules for products and sums over multisets, including when a product of a multiset is zero.

label: Lifting the circle exponential map
gloss: Lifts continuous maps through the complex exponential covering of the circle and fixes their value at zero.

label: Multilinearity of determinants
gloss: Expands a multilinear map applied to a matrix product as a sum over terms, using the determinant.

label: Fraction-ring spans of modules
gloss: Shows that every element of a submodule's span is a fraction of an element of a given form.

label: Extended natural number arithmetic
gloss: Checks that addition and casting between natural numbers and the extended natural numbers agree.

label: Span of integral elements
gloss: Shows that the span of a set of elements of a number field lies in the ring of integers when they are integral.

label: Derivative bound on closed balls
gloss: Bounds the derivative of a complex function on a closed ball by its maximum on the boundary.

label: Linear independence and finite sums
gloss: Shows that a finite sum of scalar multiples is zero only when each coefficient is zero, by induction.

label: Determinants of block triangular matrices
gloss: Computes the determinant and inverse of block triangular matrices.

label: Localization away from a prime
gloss: Shows that localizing a discrete valuation ring away from its uniformizer gives a fraction field.

label: Additive valuation of a product
gloss: Shows that the additive valuation of a finite product equals the sum of the valuations of its factors.

label: Quadratic residues over finite fields
gloss: Shows that certain quadratic polynomials over a finite field have roots, using square classes and parity of the field size.

label: Lattice generators over integers
gloss: Shows that a submodule lattice over the integers is spanned by localized generators.

label: Modules over Ore localization
gloss: Shows that a module over a discrete valuation ring has the expected structure after Ore localization.

label: Span of fractional ideals
gloss: Shows that elements of a number field can be written as integral combinations over a localization.

label: Surjectivity of localization maps
gloss: Shows that a localization map of number field integers is surjective on spans.

label: Span over fraction rings
gloss: Shows that the span of a set over a localization can be described by fractions with a common denominator.

label: Finite place triangle inequality
gloss: Proves a triangle inequality for sums of finite place contributions, by induction over finite sets of places.

label: Antitone cardinality bounds on intervals
gloss: Bounds the number of elements in finite intervals of submodules, using antitone maps.

label: Dominant weights and finite counts
gloss: Bounds the number of dominant weights in a finite set, using antitone counts.

label: Commuting endomorphism sums
gloss: Shows that the sum of powers of commuting endomorphisms behaves as expected, with zero sums vanishing.

label: Ideals of multivariate polynomial rings
gloss: Shows that ideals generated by polynomials in a local ring have the expected membership property.

label: Quotient group bijections
gloss: Builds a bijection from a quotient group by a subgroup, using lifts of its cosets.

label: Products over updated finite families
gloss: Shows that a product over a finite family, updated at one index, lies in the span of the expected set.

label: Prime ideals over number fields
gloss: Shows that a prime ideal of a Dedekind domain lies over a prime ideal of the base ring.

label: Ultrametric bounds on polynomial sums
gloss: Bounds the norm of a finite sum of polynomial evaluations in an ultrametric field.

label: Span over fraction fields
gloss: Shows that every element of a span over a fraction field has a representation with a common denominator.

label: Exponential function on the complex plane
gloss: Shows that the complex exponential satisfies its functional equation and has a derivative of the expected form.

label: Submodule lattice over fraction field
gloss: Shows that submodules of a module over a fraction field form a lattice with the expected top element.
